mapper.select: SELECT i.user_id AS userId, i.route AS route, i.resource_id AS resourceId, i.key_hash AS keyHash, i.request_hash AS requestHash, i.response_json AS responseJson, i.http_status AS httpStatus FROM idempotency_record i WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND i.route = #{route} AND i.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND i.key_hash = #{keyHash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record (user_id, route, resource_id, key_hash, request_hash, response_json, http_status, created_at) VALUES (#{r.userId}, #{r.route}, #{r.resourceId}, #{r.keyHash}, #{r.requestHash}, CAST(#{r.responseJson} AS JSON), #{r.httpStatus}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
